name: Truffle — AI Voice Companion
tagline: A 3D voice companion modelled on the builder's cat that listens, reads emotional tone and remembers what matters.
problem: People with mental health challenges need patient, non-judgmental support that does not restart from zero each time.
solution: Speech-to-text, an LLM response, and text-to-speech in a tone matched to the user's emotion, with memory of preferences and comfort style.
demo_moment: Team-described: talk to Truffle and hear a warm reply that remembers earlier conversations.

why_it_stood_out.claim: A solo build anchored in a personal story.

lessons: In voice products, warmth and memory are what make trust.
